summary: MaintHeader enables administrators to manage heading entries associated with categories, including creating, editing, deleting, and viewing heading details using a web interface. UI components support validation, workflows, and multi-language capability.
purpose: To provide a maintenance screen for managing Heading entries (such as descriptions, sort orders, notes, and localized versions) categorized by CodeCategoryID, supporting CRUD operations and administrative control.

workflows.name: View Headings
steps: User selects a category from ddCategory dropdown.
System retrieves headings for the selected category.

workflows.name: Add Heading
steps: System switches dvwDetail to Add mode.
User enters Description, DescriptionAlt, SortOrder, Notes, NotesAlt.
System hides details panel and refreshes grid.

workflows.name: Edit Heading
steps: User clicks Edit on a heading row.
System switches dvwDetail to Edit mode and populates values.
System hides details panel and refreshes grid.

workflows.name: Delete Heading
steps: User clicks Delete on a heading row.

workflows.name: Cancel Edit/Add
steps: System hides details panel without saving changes.

business_rules: Description and DescriptionAlt are mandatory fields and must be specified.
SortOrder must be specified and must be an integer.
ID and CodeCategoryID are hidden but required for row manipulations.
Notes and NotesAlt are optional fields.
Actions are tied to user session for permissions and context.
conditions: If CodeID == 0, Add operation; else, Update operation.
Page.IsValid must be true before Save.
system_behavior: Panels for error/warning display are shown or hidden based on actions.
Details panel is used for add/edit workflows.
Async update triggers for grid actions.
RefreshData reloads grid data for category selection or changes.
exceptions: Validation errors (missing/incorrect fields) shown via ValidationSummary.
Error/warning panels display messages as needed.
content_gaps: Some referenced classes (Heading, Headings, CodeCategories, Grid, UserSession, etc.) are not fully documented; business logic may depend on their implementation.
Resource files (<%$ Resources:Resources, ... %>) are referenced but not provided.
UI/UX details for confirmation dialogs and error handling are not explicit.
